outcome: Successful vaginal delivery after cesarean section
cohort: Women with a previous history of cesarean section, single pregnancy ≥37 weeks, and cephalic presentation
finding: The vaginal delivery rate after cesarean section was lower than expected according to the Grobman and Metz predictive models.
mod_finding: The study examined vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC) success rates, but did not directly compare different modes of delivery.
